RESOLUTION PASSED BY THE BOARD AT THEIR MEETING HELD ON 31.08.2024:

The Chairman informed the Board that consequent to the completion of the tenure of Mr. Dhiresh Jayasi, (DIN:06931744) Independent Director from the Directorship of the Company with effect from 28th September 2024, the Board has to re-constitute the Committees of the Board. He requested the Board to discuss reconstitution of Audit Committee (ACB), Nomination and Remuneration Committee (NRC), Stakeholders Relationship Committee (SRC), Corporate Social Responsibility Committee (CSR). Further, the Chairman drew the attention of the Board that the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI LODR relating to the said the constitution of the committees with particular reference to the members, Chairman of the Committee, and other matters as to the Committee/s, the details of the same are placed before the Board and copies circulated to the members. Chaiman requested the Board to deliberate and take decision for re-constitution of the Committees of the Board.

RE-CONSTITUTION OF AUDIT COMMITTEE (ACB)

1. Sri. Hari Desikan Ganesh Chairperson (Non-Executive - Independent Director)

2. Smt. Meenakumari S Member (Executive - Non-Independent Director)

3. Sri. Prabhu Damodaran Member (Non-Executive -Independent Director)

4. Sri. Arunkumar Jhajharia Member (Executive Director)

RE-CONSTITUTION OF NOMINATION AND REMUNERATION COMMITTEE (NRC)

1. Sri. Prabhu Damodaran Chairperson (Non-Executive - Independent Director)

2. Smt. Meenakumari S Member (Executive - Non-Independent Director)

2. Sri.Shyam Lal Agarwala Member of the Committee (Executive Director)
